summary: Tested GPT-5.4 AI Travel Assistant integration end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (3 tests) passed: SSE stream returns >120 chars of Indonesian itinerary text with expected content markers, invalid payloads correctly rejected with 422, zero-budget payload rejected with 422. Frontend Playwright flow passed: PIC role can navigate to /ai-travel, run all 3 staged selectors (BDO airport, HARRIS hotel, airport→branch transport), and generate a 4930-char Indonesian itinerary containing 'Ringkasan rekomendasi', 'Itinerary', 'Estimasi biaya', etc. Switching role selector to Manager without reload correctly renders access-denied-message (no client-side leak).
critical_code_review_comments: ai_service.py stream_travel_plan swallows all exceptions with a bare `except Exception` and returns a generic error event; consider logging the exception for observability so real API/model failures can be diagnosed in production.
AiTravelPlanRequest has no validation that start_date <= end_date and dates are ISO-format; malformed dates would still reach the LLM prompt as raw strings.

generateAiPlan in AiTravelAssistantPage.js calls JSON.parse on each SSE data line inside forEach without try/catch — a malformed chunk could throw and abort the whole loop; wrap parse in try/catch for resilience.
The SSE endpoint is unauthenticated and does not rate-limit; since it invokes a paid LLM, add a simple auth/role gate or throttling before production.
test_credentials: N/A - role selector (demo mode), no login required
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_ai_travel_plan.py is reusable. The /api/ai/travel-plan/stream endpoint takes ~13s to fully stream. AI Travel Assistant is at /ai-travel and gated by role==='PIC Accounting'. Role switch happens live via context — no reload needed. Key testids used: role-selector, start-airport-analysis-button, select-airport-bdo, select-hotel-harris, select-transport-airport-branch, generate-gpt-plan-button, gpt-travel-plan-output, access-denied-message.
